purpose: Compare candidate auditory stimulus setups, parts budgets and the evidence needed to establish precision. Research only; no assembled Rice performance is known.

scope.confirmed_probe_family: Penetrating NET threads, clarified by Howard on 2026-10-15; exact revision and connected channel count remain unknown.
exclusions: Additional import charges where not included by the seller
scope.precision_status: Component specifications and proposed bench goals are not achieved system precision.
scope.preparation: Species, physiological state, final frequency list, geometry and exposure settings must be reconfirmed before an experimental protocol. This comparison selects no animal exposure level.
scope.historical_policy: Prior source files and hardware PDF remain unchanged. New observations below are a separate dated snapshot.

basic_current_basket.playback: Computer -> UMC204HD -> one powered JBL 305P MkII -> animal reference position.
basic_current_basket.measurement: EMM-6 with individual calibration file -> UMC204HD microphone input with phantom power; confirm calibrator fit and seal. Separate recorder-compatible timing connection remains to be designed.

basic_current_basket.availability_limit: Observed asking prices and stock are unreserved and may change. No checkout occurred.
basic_current_basket.coverage_limit: JBL specifies 49 Hz-20 kHz +/-3 dB; EMM-6 nominal 18 Hz-20 kHz. Neither establishes a calibrated full 1.4-32 kHz SONIC chain. A 192 kSa/s digital interface does not extend speaker or microphone acoustic coverage.
basic_current_basket.timing_limit: No assembled sound-to-neural latency, jitter or drift has been measured. Direct-monitoring zero-latency language is not a stimulus playback guarantee.

specialized_planning_baskets.price_basis: October 9 seller observations and October 10 author-set TDT allowances, with selected major component prices rechecked October 15. Entire baskets are not current supplier quotations.
specialized_planning_baskets.tdt_allowance_limit: 1500+2000+750 = 4250 USD per magnetic-speaker basket. Author-set amounts, not public prices or supplier quotes. Confirm complete powered configuration and bundled accessories to avoid double counting.

shared_measurement_kit.note: Included once per specialized basket; a proposed addition rather than measurement hardware identified by the SONIC paper. Battery price is the older observation.

compact.playback: Computer with compatible NI-DAQmx host -> buffered USB-6361 -> powered SA1 -> MF2-M, initially free field.
compact.measurement: M50 -> MM-1 -> DAQ analog input; compatible markers captured by our neural recorder, with microphone onset measured at the reference position.
compact.coverage: MF2 nominal free-field 1-80 kHz and M50 nominal 3 Hz-50 kHz make this a candidate for the paper's 1.4-32 kHz range; assembled-chain response, distortion, uncertainty and geometry still require validation.
compact.remaining_price_scope: Small leads, proposed resistors, cord and cells retain October 9 prices. Recorder adapters remain additional.

sonic_like.playback: BNC USB-6361 -> powered SA1 -> MF1-M, with TM2500C reference and necessary accessories.
sonic_like.remaining_price_scope: Accessory prices retain October 9 observations. MF1 and complete power configuration require quotes. Our neural recorder is reused rather than reproducing Connexus.
sonic_like.reference_limit: A GPS/PTP/10 MHz reference is useful only with compatible routing and recorder support; it does not establish acoustic alignment. Confirm the recorder before selecting reference hardware.

mcginley_style_rack_historical.basis: Older used PXI/PXIe rack basket plus ES1/cable allowance and the shared measurement kit. Used offers were not refreshed in this comparison.
mcginley_style_rack_historical.limit: ES1 nominal band starts at 4 kHz, so this speaker does not directly reproduce the full 1.4-32 kHz paper range. A rack is most relevant if the lab already uses/supports it; no automatic acoustic or timestamp advantage is established.

definitions.sample_spacing: Time between waveform samples, not acoustic onset uncertainty.
definitions.fixed_latency: Repeatable delay that can be measured and corrected in timestamps.
definitions.jitter: Variation in onset/measurement delay across events.
definitions.drift: Changing mismatch between clocks over a run.
definitions.level_matching: How closely measured levels at retained frequencies match their targets.
definitions.absolute_SPL_uncertainty: Uncertainty in true sound pressure at the reference position, including microphone, calibrator, analog chain, geometry and analysis.

NI_USB6361.sample_rate_limit: Read back the actual driver-coerced rate.
NI_USB6361.spec_conditions: NI specifications default to typical at 25 degrees Celsius unless stated otherwise.
NI_USB6361.limit: Conversions illustrate a 50 ppm timebase mismatch versus ideal time; not guaranteed maximum drift, not measured relative drift against our unknown neural recorder, and not sound-to-neural timing error.

PXI4461_context.spec_conditions: +/-20 ppm over operating temperature under stated calibration/aging conditions; external clock inherits reference.
PXI4461_context.limit: Electrical component specifications do not establish microphone-onset or neural timestamp precision.

R8090.limit: +/-0.5 dB is the calibrator reference specification at 1 kHz, not whole-chain accuracy across tones or animal exposure settings. Confirm microphone fit/seal; certificate and assembled uncertainty are separate.

proposed_unmeasured_bench_goals.timestamp_scope: Absolute corrected sound-arrival-to-neural timestamp residual <=1 ms at checked points across a representative run. Measure fixed offset, jitter and drift separately; shared start trigger alone does not eliminate drift.
proposed_unmeasured_bench_goals.level_scope: Measured levels within +/-1 dB of chosen per-frequency targets for retained tones at fixed geometry, with microphone response correction. Define analysis for the actual short ramped tones. This is a level-matching goal; a separate uncertainty budget is needed to claim +/-1 dB absolute SPL accuracy.
proposed_unmeasured_bench_goals.status: Engineering discussion targets only; neither is validated for Rice. Both basic and specialized options require measurement against the actual neural recorder.
proposed_unmeasured_bench_goals.10ms_tone_context: 1 ms is 10 percent of a 10 ms tone duration. It is not the SONIC paper's 56 ms intrinsic neural processing delay.

bench_evidence_needed: Electrical output loopback and actual microphone onsets at the animal reference position
Repeated compatible markers in the neural data throughout a representative run
Measured fixed delay, event-to-event jitter and residual drift after correction
Per-frequency level, short-tone envelope and distortion measurements in fixed geometry
Calibration-file provenance and an assembled acoustic uncertainty budget
precision.neural_performance_limit: No tone-decoding accuracy or ITR can be forecast from the audio price or NET channel count alone. Coverage, usable signal, physiological preparation and decoder validation remain relevant.

recommendation: Use the basic option if a selected audible-band bench demonstration is the immediate goal. For tones extending to 27-32 kHz, favor the compact NI/TDT candidate, subject to equipment inventory, complete vendor quotes, recorder compatibility and acoustic/timing validation. Reuse or borrow suitable measurement equipment before purchasing duplicates.
actions: Public-source research and a dated repository record only. No vendor contact, message, order, hardware connection or animal/bench experiment.
